items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: See, one section was playing with Bill Mackin on the paddock... And I joined his band. And I played with him a good while.

ctx.x: Did you find yourself okay in that band?

Same, it's like, you didn't change from that same thing, you know, just want to have more men, you understand. Yeah, just more men, just like when I come out of the Navy band, the first, not a recording, but the first concert we played at the St. Charles Hotel was with Bunk Johnson and the George Lewis band, yeah. First night that you came in town, yeah, same trouble, baby, baby, baby, the doctor didn't come down, yeah. Oh. And they just come from making a tour in New York. I went to play, went to St. Charles…
Louis made a record with him, didn't he, with that, with that same band?
